_readme: Emails the classify/extract prompts were NOT tuned on, with the expected intent written down before anyone looked at the model's answer. 'burned': true means a prompt example now resembles this email (or it was used to tune), so it no longer counts as held-out; keep it as a regression case and write a fresh unseen email to replace it. Add new emails here with expected_intent set BEFORE running the check.
